entities.name: Andrzej Jastrzębiec
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Andrzej Jastrzębiec, also known as Andrzej Wasilko or Andrzej Polak, was a Polish Catholic priest and diplomat, a first bishop of Seret and of Vilnius. He was part of the Jastrzebiec ancestral line of the szlachta of Poland. He joined the Franciscans and quickly rose through the ranks of the order.
